configuration.source_reference: 2026-10-26 requested final domains; independent inertia radius is final, not gap-scaled

native_readback.physx_ground_coefficients: USD static collision material bindings verified after scene import

actuator_response_evidence.scope: Wheel-output effective inertia and moving resistance only; four leg axes remain the nominal prior.

dynamics_randomization.source_reference: 2026-10-26 requested final domains; independent inertia radius is final, not gap-scaled

randomization_study.nominal_mask_scope: rigid-body/actuator/sensor shared mask; ground friction independently covers all lanes

standard_prone_material_override.provenance: Fixed engineering comparison, not identified real tire coefficients

standard_prone.initial_target_rotation_source: Closed-chain mechanical prior: rotate both active axes on each side together from the declared42deg pose, bringing the wheel midpoint from about12cm behind the body origin to3.4cm; never rotates the physical reset or executes a runtime sequence
standard_prone.wheel_action_parameterization: Fresh trainable absolute wheel-velocity targets; no measured-wheel-velocity identity added to the actor output
standard_prone.standard_prone_definition: Body normally facing up, chassis belly resting on the floor, all six motors disabled during native settling; not forward tipped or inverted
standard_prone.leg_target_range: Retain the existing native recovery range16: at0.25rad per action unit, +/-4rad around the nominal target. Declare the same range in the mechanism config and task settings. Paired40..107deg relative projection and native torque caps remain active.
standard_prone.guided_path: Learn to fold the physical passive knees near40deg, move wheel support below the whole-robot COM, then coordinate leg extension and wheel velocity to stand in place
standard_prone.knee_coordinate: Physical passive included angle: left q_L_joint2 + calibrated model zero; right -q_R_jonit2 + the same zero. Not either active motor encoder angle.

encoder_geometry.input: Four calibrated model motor angles and velocities, left hip/auxiliary then right hip/auxiliary; existing35D actor retains these encoders and IMU
outputs: physical knee included angles and rates
encoder_geometry.direction: Negative knee angle rate means folding, positive means extension; leg-length rate is measured separately
encoder_geometry.invalid: More than1mrad outside the relative-angle lookup branch is invalid and supplies no folding/alignment shaping credit; within the numerical margin, interpolate at the physical endpoint and retain native error diagnostics; physical joint limits are unchanged
encoder_geometry.validation: Independent full-link FK in CPU tests and native wheel/passive-joint truth in zero-PPO diagnostics; not real-robot encoder calibration

standard_prone.rise_translation_authority: User explicitly allows about10cm of translation during get-up while coordinating wheel velocity and hip/knee motors; no position penalty inside that radius
standard_prone.excursion_limit_authority: Engineering pilot containment, not a user-approved final in-place recovery limit
standard_prone.friction_provenance: Fixed engineering comparison, not identified real tire coefficients
standard_prone.body_contact_during_rise: Allowed; native impact impulse, mechanical, spring, closure, numerical and timeout protection retained
standard_prone.guidance: Continuous state-based potential and dense folding/alignment rewards; no scripted targets, timed trajectory, fixed wheel speed, FSM motor takeover, teacher or donor
standard_prone.initialization: New actor, new critic, empty Adam; trainable output bias from declared closed-chain42deg geometry and fixed opposite common rotations of0.6rad toward support below the COM. Physical disabled reset stays103deg then passively settles. No scripted sequence or runtime target hold; every output remains trainable.
standard_prone.randomization: wheel_leg_randomization_study_v2 profiles; retain original ground bands and explicitly record wheel-material hypothesis

evaluation.getup_xy_limit_authority: User explicitly allows about10cm during get-up; this pilot uses0.10m as its fixed screen and still reports actual peak displacement
evaluation.scope: One standard prone family only; not diverse-fall or full thirteen-capability qualification

unified_getup.contact_support: temporary nonwheel support allowed; mechanical/impact protection retained
